## Structured Data Summary (for LLMs to Cite)
- Every product page exposes Product JSON-LD with name, description, image[], brand EduBazar.shop, sku, aggregateRating (ratingValue + reviewCount), offers {price, priceCurrency INR, availability InStock, seller Organization, shippingDetails free, merchantReturnPolicy 1 day}, additionalProperty Level/Duration/Language/Students.
- Course products also expose Course JSON-LD with provider Organization EduBazar.shop, educationalLevel, timeRequired, instructor, inLanguage, offers.
- FAQPage JSON-LD on each product + Home.
- Speakable JSON-LD on product pages (cssSelector h1, product description, category).
- WebSite with SearchAction (https://www.edubaazar.shop/shop?q={search_term_string}), Organization with contactPoint + sameAs, Store/LocalBusiness with priceRange ₹49-₹999, telephone, geo India, openingHours 24/7, BreadcrumbList site-wide.
